proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ G _ S _ i
  refine ⟨G.adjMatrix_mul_self_apply_self i, by simp [Matrix.trace], ?_⟩
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_mul_self_apply_self]
  have := G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → S) this
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (S : Type*) [CommSemiring S] (i : V), (G.adjMatrix S * G.adjMatrix S) i i = (G.degree i : S) ∧ Matrix.trace (G.adjMatrix S) = 0 ∧ Matrix.trace (G.adjMatrix S * G.adjMatrix S) = 2 * (G.edgeFinset.card : S)
